verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents several headless control surfaces. Terraform/OpenTofu manages clusters, VPCs, storage and inference resources as code. A CKS API creates, lists, updates and deletes clusters, and the Inference API offers generated clients in many languages. Bearer API access tokens plus downloadable kubeconfigs enable non-interactive kubectl use, and these together support CI-driven automation. Missing for 10: an explicit CI/CD integration guide, a dedicated first-party CLI, documented machine/service-account credentials for pipelines, headless equivalents for console-only tasks like Capacity Finder and quota views, and independent hands-on corroboration.
